test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2nd December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: If ‘N’ is the wife of ‘M’, ‘A’ is the sister of ‘R’, ‘S’ is the mother of ‘N’, ‘K’ is the brother of ‘M’ and ‘R’ is the son of ‘N’, then how is ‘K’ related to ‘A’?
solution:
By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e70b8fc59f55523cbd1c0dcb6157cdd0120d14d1918de4106bf11139640dba2e.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4cd016aab66b80a250650d1146632c87a86f3a9e3353e5473bb7115db259ca5c.png] 

Clearly, K is the paternal uncle of A.

Hence, '**Paternal uncle**' is the correct answer.
